lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the domain-docs write into the /cam-spec final step

openQuestions: All userStories in prd.json now have passes:true (no operator-required stories remain either). This PRD (CAM-118 domain-docs-writer) is COMPLETE: the next agent invocation should read prd.json, find nothing with passes:false, and emit PRD_COMPLETE so the orchestrator runs /cam-review.

bun run check:all has one pre-existing, environment-level failure unrelated to this story: the `dead-code` gate shells out to `bunx knip@latest`, which resolves a knip build that imports `styleText` from `node:util` -- unavailable on the sandbox's Node 18.20.4 (styleText landed in Node 20+). This reproduces identically on a clean checkout with NO changes from this story (verified via `git stash` + rerun), so it predates US-004 and is an environment/toolchain mismatch (bunx resolving a knip build too new for the pinned Node), not a code defect introduced here. Flagging for the reviewer/operator: either pin an older knip version compatible with Node 18, or ensure the CI/sandbox runner's Node is >=20 where `bunx knip` actually runs (bun itself doesn't need node, but bunx here shells to a node-based knip build under the hood).

test/dashboard.test.ts 'k after j returns to first row' occasionally fails under the full `bun test` parallel run (not in isolation) because ink's getWindowSize() calls out to a real `tput`/terminal-size probe subject to environment flakiness in a headless/CI-like sandbox; reran bun test twice, saw 1 fail then 0 fail with no code changes in between. Pre-existing flake, not introduced by this story.
nextStoryContext: US-004 was the last story in the CAM-118 domain-docs-writer PRD (US-001..US-004, no operator-required stories were ever added). The full pipeline is now: /cam-spec runs the grill-with-docs interview -> specifyIssueOnMain persists the spec on main -> the orchestrator assembles a DomainDocsPayload from the interview (glossary terms + only decisions passing all three ADR gates: hard-to-reverse, surprising-without-context, real-trade-off) -> pipes it via `cam spec --write-docs <id> <<'EOF' ... EOF` (single-quoted heredoc only, CAM-106) -> writeDomainDocsOnMain commits CONTEXT.md/docs/adr/ to main atomically. Both .claude/commands/cam-spec.md and templates/commands/cam-spec.md carry the new 'Final step: persist the domain docs' section plus three new Error handling rows (malformed/invalid payload, diverged/detached-head, noOp) verbatim (agent-prompt self-hosting pattern); src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` and embed-vendor:check is clean. No test file needed updating: test/embedded.test.ts's byte-parity assertions and the 'cam-spec.md references grill-with-docs' regression test are unaffected since both copies stayed identical and the grill-with-docs reference was untouched. The next agent invocation (if this handoff is somehow read before a fresh /cam-plan cycle) should treat this PRD as done and defer to PRD_COMPLETE / the review cycle rather than hunting for more work here.
